snippet.title: ASBAK - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
ASBAK website: https://asbak.vifthfloor.moe/
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932110/Asbak/

Slice through fear itself in this high-speed 2D hack-and-slash! As a government-backed demon hunter, chase down and destroy demons born from humanity’s darkest fears. Move fast, hit hard, and keep the nightmares at bay!

Demo coming soon to Steam! 👁️👁️
